解：椭圆$\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$的参数方程是$$\begin{cases}x=a\cos\theta\\y=b\sin\theta\end{cases}\quad\theta从0变到2\pi$$
原式$$\int_0^{2\pi}[(a\cos\theta+b\sin\theta)(-a\sin\theta)+(a\cos\theta-b\sin\theta)b\cos\theta]d\theta$$
$$=\int_0^{2\pi}\left(ab\cos2\theta-\frac{a^2+b^2}{2}\sin2\theta\right)d\theta=0$$
